en: A black and white photograph showing the entrance to a military barracks complex. The gate is guarded by soldiers, and there are two large buildings flanking the entrance. Visible is a flag with a swastika, indicating Nazi Germany. The landscape in the background is open and flat. The text at the bottom reads 'Artillerie-Kaserne, Meissen-Bohnitzsch'. Handwritten blue text at the top includes a name and the number '27860'.
